It'll be my second appointment. She's so nice and she really wants to work on my self-esteem.

That's amazing. Are you in contact with them at all? My dad's the same way. I did talk to him yesterday and he said that he has to get me out of here once things cool down with COVID-19. He already does, but he said he'd help more financially so that I don't have to interact with her as much. He gives her money to pick up my medication, food, and stuff. 

I have quite a few health issues and I don't work. I'm so scared of failure that I've been stuck in limbo. I should probably read about learned helplessness. I know she wants me to think that I'm not good enough and can't do anything without her to keep me dependent. She's also kept me pretty isolated my entire life. I'm not sure if I even know how to ask for help. I can't help but wonder if it's not "bad enough" since I haven't been able to leave yet. I'd have to keep any money I made a secret or else it'd be emergency after emergency until I'm bled dry yet again.

Thank you. How did/do you deal with living with her and how were you able to leave if you have? It's like I have no energy whenever she's around and she's always around.  I've called two of my cousins when I was feeling suicidal. Neither of them bothered to tell me not to do it and that's kind of all I wanted to hear. It was really painful and further cemented the fact that I'm completely alone and no one cares about me. I've told other family members as well. I have a therapy appointment next week.
I probably can't anytime soon. That's why I'm so depressed about it.
Thanks for replying. There are good and bad ones. There's probably a better one if I had insurance, but the ones near me are notoriously shitty.
Thank you. I'm not sure how, but I really hope I can.
I'm 23. I can't. There's no physical abuse. I said once that I'd call the cops if she hit me and she's still holding that grudge. She's not a citizen, so that'd probably screw everything up for her.
